The *Aḍḍhakāsitherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 37) is a verse text preserved in the *Therīapadāna* section of the Pali canon, recording the biographical narrative and past aspirations of the nun Aḍḍhakāsī [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral notes five translations of the text across five languages [SuttaCentral].
Textual reuse data generated by DharmaNexus indicates heavy reliance on formulaic and shared material common to the *Therīapadāna*. The text shares 142 matching passages with 33 Pali texts, most prominently with the commentary to the *Therīgāthā* (*Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*), with which it shares 40 passages amounting to more than 7,000 characters (particularly across segments §0.3–14.1) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, recurring stock verses—especially in segments §11.1–18.1—are shared with multiple other narratives in the collection, such as the *Siṅgālamātutherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 34), the *Sukkātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 35), the *Uppaladāyikātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 33), the *Abhirūpanandātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 36), the *Ambapālitherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 39), and the *Uppalavaṇṇātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 19) [DharmaNexus].
